title: File the partnership return and K-1s
summary: Close the year's books, file the entity's tax return and deliver each investor's K-1.
outlineSteps: Close the year's books and reconcile them to the bank statements
Book the year's depreciation and amortization
Compute taxable income apart from cash flow
Allocate income, loss and distributions under the governing agreement
Collect investor tax information and address changes
Send the year-end package to the tax preparer
Review the draft return and K-1s
Approve and file the return or an extension
Answer investor questions and file the copies
